sectors._comment: Nominal sector split distances in km from start/finish line.

pit._comment: All pit-lane timing constants for Bathurst. Values sourced from published supplementary regulations. Adjust per-event as needed.
pit._comment_minPit: Minimum stationary time enforced by regulations (not total pit lane transit).
pit._comment_transit: Typical full pit-lane transit time at 40 km/h speed limit (entry to exit). This is how long a car is off the track — it does NOT drive the blocking window calculation.
pit._comment_ontrack: On-track travel time (seconds) from the pit lane entry ramp to the pit exit merge point, measured along the racing circuit (not through the pit lane). At Bathurst: ~0.533 km at ~160 km/h ≈ 12 s. This is the reference point for blocking: a rival running within blockingWindowSeconds of this gap will arrive at the pit exit merge point at the same moment the pitting car emerges.
pit._comment_window: null closeLap means window stays open to the end of the race. Override per-event.
pit._comment_blocking: Tolerance either side of pitEntryToExitOnTrackSeconds (seconds). Any car whose on-track gap falls in [onTrack - tolerance, onTrack + tolerance] is in the blocking window. Green = clear, orange = marginal (within one tolerance band of the boundary), red = inside the window.
pit._comment_unsafe: Minimum gap (seconds) at pit exit to avoid an unsafe release penalty.

raceFormat._comment: type: 'laps' | 'time_minutes'. value: number (lap count or minutes). Override per-event.

analysis._comment: Fuel effect constant in s/kg. Set via Fuel Sensitivity panel. Used to fuel-correct lap times for tyre degradation analysis.
analysis._comment_fuel: Starting fuel load in kg. Used with fuelSensitivitySKg to compute per-lap fuel correction. Default 120 kg for Supercars Bathurst 1000.

trackMap._comment: CSV with columns: lat,lon,distance_km. File path relative to config/. Leave empty or omit if no GPS data.
trackMap._comment_fraction: Position of start/finish line as a fraction of total lap distance (0.0 = start of CSV data).
trackMap._comment_image: Optional: absolute path to a PNG/JPG/SVG track map image. Displayed when no GPS data is available. E.g. /Users/you/tracks/bathurst.png
